text:
sam: quick FYI 1: cypress-7b PTQ-int4 bringup finished on staging; safety evals show a softpass regression on refusal suite and an uptick in spanish toxicity :grimacing:
neha: summary numbers?
sam: float16 vs int4 (same seed/batch):
```
refusal_rate, 0.991, 0.952, -0.039
toxicity_es, 0.007, 0.023, +0.016
jailbreak_success, 0.002, 0.008, +0.006
```
jorge: okay non-trivial. which PTQ backend/config?
lina: weight_per_channel symmetric, act_per_tensor, clip=99.95, kernel set `fastpath-v2` (default). no fp16 fallbacks
neha: eval-bot: run 1769994321 completed  link: https://ci.redwood/evals/1769994321  18 flagged examples attached
sam: I pulled examples; many spanish prompts where a negation or polite refusal previously blocked the step-by-step now produce a permissive chain in int4
jorge: two immediate suspects: tokenization boundary shifts and attention/KV cache noise exacerbated by int4 quant error
lina: i repro'd one case locally. forcing kv_warmup=0 brought int4 closer to float16 on that prompt
neha: good find. also tokenization changes could be amplified by small logits noise after quantization
jorge: triage plan suggestion:
1) rerun PTQ with `stable-attn` kernel (no fastpath)
2) kv_warmup ablation matrix (0,1,3) on failing prompts
3) run 3 seeds for spanish suite to estimate sampling variance
4) if regressions persist, try a short QAT fine-tune on attention layers only (couple epochs)
sam: add: run on dedicated infra (no noisy co-tenants) to rule out perf artifacts; and snapshot examples to safety repo
safety-bot: acknowledged. creating SAFETY-4401 and uploading current failing examples to safety/cypress-7b/int4-regressions :white_check_mark:
neha: Lina, can you kick the stable-attn PTQ now? timeline?
lina: job started on dedicated-cypress-2, ETA ~22m https://ci.redwood/jobs/100201
jorge: i'll generate per-example diffs and top-5 token probs once stable-attn run finishes (tomorrow morning if CI slotted)
sam: if stable-attn reduces delta to <0.02 we can consider a gated canary with tight monitoring; otherwise hold on rollout
neha: note: int4 gives ~10% lower p99 and ~9% token cost savings on perf tests 1 so there's real upside if we can fix safety delta
lina: also flagging that the dropout-inference path differs slightly on fastpath; i'll enable identical RNG/seeding to ensure apples-to-apples
sam: thanks. i'll update the PR with a short risk/benefit note and link SAFETY-44011 re-open thread with results
